type.description: The message name — <name> in the routing key.

domain.description: The owning domain — <domain> in the routing key. Names the role, not the vendor.

kind.description: Which exchange carries this message. Never reaches the routing key.

ts.description: The PUBLISH instant — when this message went out, ISO-8601 UTC. A republish has the same content and a new ts.

target.description: The switcher this message addresses — the <target> routing segment: the switcher's configured name, 'main' by default. Required on every switcher message.

link.description: The switcher's link: connected, connecting or dropped. Anything but connected means the document holds the last the switcher reported, not live state.

propertyNames.description: A virtual name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (^[a-z0-9-]+$), room-computers' rule.

tally.description: The computer's light, in the switcher's words: program, preview or off.

color.description: The light's colour, '#rrggbb' or '#rrggbbaa'. Present exactly when tally isn't off.

additionalProperties.title: Computer
additionalProperties.description: One mapped computer's light: its tally and, when lit, its colour.

computers.description: Virtual name → the computer's light. Every mapped computer is listed; empty when none is mapped.

SwitcherTallyChanged.description: The switcher's tally — every mapped room computer by virtual name, with its light and, when lit, its colour; and the basic state's link. color is present exactly when tally isn't off; computers may be empty. Published when it differs in meaning.
